title: µG-NeuroTune: a validated maturation, dopaminergic-fidelity and stress scorecard for human midbrain organoids
description: Open-source scorecard that tells whether human midbrain organoids are genuinely maturing or showing stress/hypoxia-driven 'maturation-like' changes. Includes validation on known-age organoids, anchoring to human fetal ventral-midbrain development, a stratified LEO-vs-ground comparison with a hypoxia-adjusted test, a power calculator for future spaceflight experiments, an oxygen-transport model of the CRS-19 culture vial, and a browser scorecard.
